newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's 1996 PSBR worse than expected-Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy's 1996 PSBR worse than expected-Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Wednesday that Italy's public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) for 1996 was worse than expected and was in line with 1995's 130 trillion lire level.
"The trend is worse that expected," Ciampi told a news conference. "The trend of the first 10 months appears to show that this year's PSBR is more or less in line with 1995."
The government had forecast 1996 PSBR of 123 trillion lire.
The Bank of Italy said last week that Italy's January to September PSBR was up 2.5 trillion lire to 95.9 trillion lire.
